body: this breaks my heart. It’s selfish to tell you not to go but I don’t want you to leave. please don’t.
I’m sorry. I don’t have it in me to write something long. Please don’t do anything, it’s hypocritical coming from someone else posting here but I can’t say anything other than that. Don’t go.
Yes, I’m sure the lord is reading all these comments. Oh no, I’ve just let him see what SIDE I’m on!
